<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->
On the Muse Spark NVFP4 MoE path with a static activation scale (no per-token activation scaling), the pre-expert RMSNorm and the NVFP4 quantization of its output run as two separate kernels, writing and re-reading the normalized bf16 activations in between.
The existing fused RMSNorm + NVFP4 kernel only covers the per-token-scale path.

Rebased onto `main` .

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->
- `kernels/jit/csrc/muse_spark/norm_fp4_quant.cuh`: add a static-scale mode to the fused RMSNorm + NVFP4 quantization kernel, using a single fp32 global scale; the quantization matches FlashInfer's CUDA `fp4_quantize`.
- `kernels/ops/layernorm/muse_spark_rmsnorm_nvfp4_quant.py`: expose it as `fused_norm_fp4_quant_static(x, weight, eps, global_scale) -> (fp4, sf)`.
- `layers/muse_spark/muse_spark_fp4_moe.py`: on the static-scale path, replace the separate pre-expert norm and quantization with the fused op.

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

Muse Spark Open NVFP4, aggregated TP4/EP4 on 4x GB300 (cookbook GB300 NVFP4 flags, no speculative decoding). Base is upstream `main` `693d333306`; this PR is the same tree plus this change.

Both servers run with:
- `SGLANG_FLASHINFER_NVFP4_PER_TOKEN_ACTIVATION=0` set explicitly, so the MoE input uses the static activation scale, which is the path this PR fuses. The Muse Spark hook turns per-token activation on when the variable is unset.
- `--disable-flashinfer-autotune`, so both sides run identical fixed MoE GEMM tactics.

sgl-eval, xhigh reasoning, T=1.0 / top_p=1.0 / top_k=64:

| | Base | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| GSM8K (64K max tokens) | 97.73% | 97.73% |
| AIME26 x16 (128K max tokens), pass@1 ± SEM | 96.25 ± 0.85% | 96.25 ± 0.60% |
| AIME26 x16, pass@16 | 100% | 100% |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

Same servers and settings as above (per-token activation off, FlashInfer autotune off). AIPerf, 8K input / 1K output per request with a shared 32K cached prefix, 10 x c requests per concurrency level.

| c | OTPS base | OTPS PR | Gain |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 171 | 181 | 1.06x |
| 2 | 296 | 311 | 1.05x |
| 4 | 501 | 525 | 1.05x |
| 8 | 807 | 833 | 1.03x |
| 16 | 1,222 | 1,252 | 1.02x |
| 32 | 1,738 | 1,749 | 1.01x |
| 64 | 2,356 | 2,376 | 1.01x |
| 128 | 3,006 | 3,038 | 1.01x |

- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
-"""Fused RMS norm + per-token NVFP4 quantization for MuseSpark v1.2.
+"""Fused RMS norm + (per-token) NVFP4 quantization for MuseSpark v1.2.
 
 Byte-exact with FlashInfer's per-token ``layout_linear`` CuTe-DSL quantizer on
-the same bf16 row.
+the same bf16 row. The static-scale mode matches FlashInfer's CUDA ``fp4_quantize``.
 """
 
 from __future__ import annotations
@@ -48,9 +48,16 @@ def _jit_module(hidden_size: int, num_threads: int) -> Module:
         *args,
         cuda_files=["muse_spark/norm_fp4_quant.cuh"],
         cuda_wrappers=[
-            ("run_quant", f"MuseSparkNormFp4Quant<{args}, true, false>::run"),
-            ("run_quant_normed", f"MuseSparkNormFp4Quant<{args}, true, true>::run"),
-            ("run_normed", f"MuseSparkNormFp4Quant<{args}, false, true>::run"),
+            ("run_quant", f"MuseSparkNormFp4Quant<{args}, true, false, false>::run"),
+            (
+                "run_quant_normed",
+                f"MuseSparkNormFp4Quant<{args}, true, true, false>::run",
+            ),
+            ("run_normed", f"MuseSparkNormFp4Quant<{args}, false, true, false>::run"),
+            (
+                "run_quant_static",
+                f"MuseSparkNormFp4Quant<{args}, true, false, true>::run",
+            ),
         ],
     )
 
@@ -99,7 +106,7 @@ def _fused_norm_fp4_quant_jit(
         fn = module.run_quant
     else:
         fn = module.run_normed
-    fn(x, weight, normed, fp4, sf, pts, float(eps), float(global_scale_inv))
+    fn(x, weight, normed, fp4, sf, pts, None, float(eps), float(global_scale_inv))
     return fp4, sf, pts, normed
 
 
@@ -304,3 +311,31 @@ def fused_norm_fp4_quant(
         quantize=quantize,
         want_normed=want_normed,
     )
+
+
+def fused_norm_fp4_quant_static(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    eps: float,
+    global_scale: torch.Tensor,
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Return ``(fp4, sf)``: RMS norm, then NVFP4 with the static fp32 ``global_scale``.
+
+    ``fp4`` is ``[M, K/2]`` uint8 and ``sf`` is ``[M, K/16]`` uint8 (e4m3 bits,
+    row-major).
+    """
+    assert x.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and x.dim() == 2 and x.is_contiguous()
+    assert global_scale.dtype == torch.float32 and global_scale.numel() == 1
+    m, hidden_size = x.shape
+    if weight is not None:
+        assert weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and weight.shape == (hidden_size,)
+        weight = weight.contiguous()
+    fp4 = torch.empty(m, hidden_size // 2, dtype=torch.uint8, device=x.device)
+    sf = torch.empty(m, hidden_size // _BLOCK, dtype=torch.uint8, device=x.device)
+    if m == 0:
+        return fp4, sf
+    module = _jit_module(hidden_size, _num_threads(hidden_size))
+    module.run_quant_static(
+        x, weight, None, fp4, sf, None, global_scale.reshape(1), float(eps), 0.0
+    )
+    return fp4, sf

@@ -24,6 +24,7 @@
 )
 from sglang.kernels.ops.layernorm.muse_spark_rmsnorm_nvfp4_quant import (
     fused_norm_fp4_quant,
+    fused_norm_fp4_quant_static,
 )
 from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.muse_spark_post_expert_finalize_triton import (
     fused_post_expert_norm_weighted_sum,
@@ -584,9 +585,15 @@ def prepare_input(
             hs_scale_linear = hs_sf_bytes.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).reshape(
                 seq_len, hidden_size // 16
             )
+        elif pre_expert_norm is not None:
+            per_token_scale = None
+            hs_fp4, hs_scale_linear = fused_norm_fp4_quant_static(
+                hidden_states,
+                self._pre_norm_weight(pre_expert_norm),
+                pre_expert_norm.eps,
+                self.w13_input_scale_quant,
+            )
         else:
-            if pre_expert_norm is not None:
-                hidden_states = pre_expert_norm(hidden_states)
             # Match the known-good public vLLM activation path. SGLang's
             # helper selects FlashInfer's experimental CuTeDSL quantizer on
             # SM100, while vLLM's scaled_fp4_quant uses the stable CUDA
